Provisioning._note: Per SQL server: DataFolder = where a new client DB's .mdf/.ldf go (RESTORE ... MOVE); BackupFolder = where the temporary .bak is staged ON THAT SERVER. Keyed by server host/IP — a ',1433' port and '\instance' suffix are stripped before lookup. Folders are auto-created via xp_create_subdir. A server not listed here (or whose folder can't be created) falls back to that server's own SQL default data/log/backup paths. Set because some boxes' C: drive is full (3.6.241.120 C: = 0 MB free). The temp .bak is deleted after a successful restore. NOTE: 15.206.241.195 (Printude) is only reachable from the deployed backend, not from a dev box.

BackupRestore._note: BulkImport DatabaseBackupRestore. These folders must exist + be writable by the app-pool identity on the host.
